main_text.head: Quid est Dages?
main_text.p: Dages est punctum in ventre literæ, hoc modo, ב: Estq; forte aut lene.
main_text.head: Quid est Dages forte?
main_text.p: Quod in medio vocis post vocalem brevem, consonam duplicat, hoc est, unam in geminam dividit, ut שִׁבֵּר schibbèr, ac si essent duo ב. Omnesq; consonæ illud admittunt, exceptis א aleph, ה he, ח heth, ע ajin, ר resch. Atttamen ה he habet in vetre punctum Mappik appellatum, quo indicatur consonam ה he proferendam esse, ut יָדָהּ jadach, manus ejus.
main_text.head: Quid est Dages lene?
main_text.p: Quod in principio, & medio vocis post scheva quiescens consonam fortificat, sed non geminat, ut, בן filius : אשבר efchbór, frangam. Et locum habet in sex consonis בגדכפת beghadh kephath, quas intendit ac duras reddit. Nam lene nominatur respectu fortis tanquam durioris.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh/mappik marks are approximated from the scan; the forms שִׁבֵּר, יָדָהּ and בגדכפת may differ in their points and should be checked against the image. The "Dages" marks in the Latin text (e.g. "Estq;") are read as printed.
